details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 UTMB stat block: 174 km. The same official page also says approximately 170 km in its introduction and totals 176.865 km in its timing table; a raw parse of the official GPX measures 173.83 km. This card uses the stat block.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2026 UTMB stat block: 9,700 m positive gain. The official timing table totals +10,000 m and the introduction says about 10,000 m; a raw GPX parse sums to +10,253 m. This card uses the stat block.
